symptom: A successful CLI JSON envelope may contain only metadata, a note or an attachment error.
cause: The upstream command wraps a text response, including error or fallback text, without proving a paper body exists.
resolution: Require the verified Full Text section and nonempty body
Verify actual PDF page coverage before claiming whole-paper reading

verification.check: Inspected retrieval get_item_fulltext; simulated metadata-only, note-only and empty Full Text responses are rejected

limitations: The section marker is verified for version 0.11.0. Recheck parser behavior after upgrades; a body still does not prove all PDF pages were read.
